description:
Creates a public post pinned to a location for the signed-in user; everyone can see it immediately.
Hashtags are written inline in the message as #tag (the last 10 are indexed for search).
To attach images, first call get_publishing_media_keys and pass the returned keys as medias.
Returns the new post's id, geoHash and public url. Velocity limit: 5 per 10 minutes and 50 per day.

latitude.description: Latitude of the post location, between -90 and 90. Example: 48.8566.

longitude.description: Longitude of the post location, between -180 and 180. Example: 2.3522.

medias.description: Media keys from get_publishing_media_keys, at most 7.

message.description: Text of the post, at most 6000 characters, #hashtags inline.

name: create_post

id.description: Id of the new post; pass it with geoHash to get_post or create_comment.

url.description: Public page of the new post or event.

title: Create post
